_doc: What Champollion does with the HuggingFace translation-model sweep, and why. DECISIONS, not facts: every rule here is a choice that could reasonably have gone another way, so each records its reason and the evidence it was made against. Consumed by cli/scripts/cldf/ingest-hf-models.mjs; the sweep itself is pinned at cli/data/hf-models/SNAPSHOT.json.
_founderDirection: Index everything that resolves; do not gatekeep on downloads. A tiny community fine-tune for a low-resource language is exactly what no other index lists, and a popularity floor would cut precisely the models this project exists to surface.

observed._note: 1,731 distinct declared codes against the 608 languages that have any method coverage today. That gap is the reason for doing this at all.

languageSource.reason: NOT the tags array. Framework tags collide with ISO 639-3: `jax` is also Jambi Malay, `mms` is also Southern Mam, `pt` is also Portuguese. Scraping tags would announce coverage no author ever claimed, on thousands of models at once.
languageSource.variantReason: Model-card frontmatter is user-authored YAML and the key is misspelled in the wild. Reading only the canonical spelling silently drops models whose authors did declare a language; reading all three is a decision, recorded here rather than buried in the reader.

included.rule: every model whose card declares at least one language code that resolves through the tag index
included.reason: Resolution is the only filter. A model that declares nothing cannot produce an edge — there is no language to attach it to — and that is a property of the model, not a judgement about it.

excluded.reason: not readable, so nothing about them can be verified

excluded.rule: gated repositories are INDEXED but flagged
excluded.reason: a gated model exists and its card is public; what is gated is the weights. Excluding it would hide a real resource, and treating it as freely usable would misinform someone planning a run.

derivation.rule: record cardData.base_model where declared; never infer it
derivation.reason: 5,391 models cite a base model, which makes the derivation a fact with a source. Many more are plainly derivative and do not say so — WindstormLabs publishes 3,139 models named `origin-Helsinki-NLP-opus-mt-*` with no base_model field, and manancode publishes 1,361 ctranslate2 conversions tagged `opus-mt`. Inferring derivation from a repository NAME would be exactly the manufacturing this rebuild exists to end, so it is not done: the name is not a citation.
derivation.consequence: A method count that treats every upload as an independent capability is inflated, and this is the same defect as counting omt1600's claimed 1,600 beside verified lists. So the atlas records `derivedFrom` where it is declared, and any count that matters must say whether it is counting uploads or independent methods.

codesThatWillNotResolve.reason: `multilingual` is not a language. `aav` (Austro-Asiatic) and `mul` are COLLECTION codes covering many languages, and expanding a collection into its members would assert coverage of each — the same propagation error the macrolanguage rule exists to prevent. They are counted as unresolved and named, never expanded.

verificationLevel.reason: The weakest tier in the register, below `publisher-count-only`. A vendor's documented language list is a considered statement about a deployed service; a self-applied tag on a fine-tune is one line of YAML nobody reviewed. A card showing both identically would flatten a real difference in how much anyone checked.
